footer: • ASCE 7-22 Sec. 3.1.2 requires actual weights; commentary values are non-mandatory. Manufacturer data governs where available.
• ASCE masonry weights include mortar but not plaster; add 5 psf per plastered face. Values are averages; actual range can be considerable.
• ASCE CMU wythe values are by nominal thickness. Firm pcf rows: enter actual thickness.
• Firm values for MEP, sprinkler, and miscellaneous are minimums; increase to round out DL (verify with manager).
• Table C3.1-1b (SI) omitted: it duplicates C3.1-1a and units are not mixed on this sheet.
• Composite deck rows: Vulcraft Deck Solutions 2026 LRFD, 'Concrete + Deck' column. Values include deck self-weight; catalog uses NWC 145 pcf and LWC 110 pcf (firm NWC rows use 150 pcf).
• Composite deck weights are theoretical: no allowance for concrete ponding from deck/framing deflection. Add per firm practice/EOR.
• 1.5VLR-36: catalog p. 144 slab-information table repeats the 1.5VL volumes, which do not match the 1.5VLR weights (VLR is ~5 psf heavier). Tabulated weights used.
